description: Queue a real order on the user's live MT5 account through the MT5 Bridge EA. REAL MONEY: only call this after the user has explicitly approved the exact symbol, direction, volume, entry, stop loss and take profit. Never place orders on your own initiative. If the result is `needs_confirmation`, show every warning to the user and only retry with those keys in `acknowledgeWarnings` if the user says to place it anyway. Market orders expire if the EA does not pick them up within ~20s; check `get_my_mt5_account` for the result. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Warnings from a previous needs_confirmation result that the user chose to override

price.description: Required for LIMIT/STOP orders, ignored for market

symbol.description: Broker-neutral symbol, e.g. EURUSD, XAUUSD (EA maps suffixes)

name: place_mt5_order
title: Place MT5 order
